steps.octave: An octave spans eight white keys, from a note to the next one with the same name. To jump an octave, keep the hand’s shape and move it as a whole: look at where it lands before you go, move early, and land lightly.
steps.octaveEcho: A phrase, its echo an octave higher, and home again.
steps.bassOctaves: In the left hand, octave jumps make the bass deeper: each bass note, then the same note an octave lower. The pedal, changed with each chord, keeps the sound joined while the hand jumps.
steps.octaveBass: The chords from Unit 6, over a bass that jumps down an octave in every bar.
